main_measure.name: slope of the coin's demeaned 14-bar forward return on the forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope t >= 2 with timing gain > 0; reject: t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive; at least 300 grid cases with non-zero forecast

supporting_check.name: timing gain: book mean daily return minus position x coin mean daily return

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The regression is an OLS with intercept over every grid bar of each window (positions 0, 14, 28, ... with a full 14-bar return inside the window, zero-forecast bars included), each coin's mean 14-bar return is taken over those same grid samples of all its windows, and the timing gain averages the coins per UTC day before averaging over days.
